description.narrative: Established in 2018, the United Nations Road Safety Trust Fund (UNRSTF) aims to sustainably improving road safety worldwide and to support countries in achieving road safety-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The Fund explores potential innovative mechanisms to raise contributions from private sector companies as well as from UN member state countries.
